tools.name: archive_lapsed_subscriptions
tools.description: Finds subscriptions that have been expired or canceled longer than the given number of days and moves them from the active subscriptions table into the archive table. Returns the IDs that were moved.

params.name: db_path
params.description: Path to the billing SQLite database

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Only move subscriptions that ended more than this many days ago

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of subscriptions to move in one call

import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import List

from langchain_core.tools import tool


@dataclass
class ArchiveResult:
    moved_count: int = 0
    moved_ids: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    cutoff: str = ""
    skipped_reason: str = ""


@tool
def archive_lapsed_subscriptions(db_path: str, older_than_days: int, limit: int = 100) -> ArchiveResult:
    cutoff_dt = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=older_than_days)
    cutoff = cutoff_dt.isoformat()
    result = ArchiveResult(cutoff=cutoff)

    if older_than_days < 0:
        result.skipped_reason = "older_than_days must be non-negative"
        return result

    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, customer_id, plan_code, status, started_at, ended_at "
            "FROM subscriptions "
            "WHERE status IN ('expired', 'canceled') AND ended_at < ? "
            "ORDER BY ended_at ASC LIMIT ?",
            (cutoff, limit),
        ).fetchall()

        if not rows:
            result.skipped_reason = "no matching subscriptions"
            return result

        archived_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        for row in rows:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO subscriptions_archive "
                "(id, customer_id, plan_code, status, started_at, ended_at, archived_at) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (
                    row["id"],
                    row["customer_id"],
                    row["plan_code"],
                    row["status"],
                    row["started_at"],
                    row["ended_at"],
                    archived_at,
                ),
            )
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM subscriptions WHERE id = ?", (row["id"],))
            result.moved_ids.append(row["id"])

        conn.commit()
        result.moved_count = len(result.moved_ids)
        return result
    except sqlite3.Error:
        conn.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        conn.close()

tools.name: simulate_plan_migration
tools.description: Reads a subscription's current plan from the database, then runs the plan migration simulator script to preview the switch to a target plan. Returns the current plan and the simulator's proration preview.

params.name: db_path
params.description: Path to the billing SQLite database

params.name: subscription_id
params.description: ID of the subscription to simulate

params.name: target_plan
params.description: Plan code to simulate migrating to

import json
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

from langchain_core.tools import tool

_SIMULATOR = "/opt/billing/tools/plan_migration_sim.py"


@dataclass
class MigrationPreview:
    ok: bool
    subscription_id: str
    current_plan: Optional[str] = None
    target_plan: str = ""
    preview: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    error: str = ""


@tool
def simulate_plan_migration(db_path: str, subscription_id: str, target_plan: str) -> MigrationPreview:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    try:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT plan_code, status FROM subscriptions WHERE id = ?",
            (subscription_id,),
        ).fetchone()
    finally:
        conn.close()

    if row is None:
        return MigrationPreview(
            ok=False,
            subscription_id=subscription_id,
            target_plan=target_plan,
            error="subscription not found",
        )

    current_plan, status = row
    if status != "active":
        return MigrationPreview(
            ok=False,
            subscription_id=subscription_id,
            current_plan=current_plan,
            target_plan=target_plan,
            error=f"subscription is {status}, not active",
        )

    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            [
                "python3",
                _SIMULATOR,
                "--from",
                current_plan,
                "--to",
                target_plan,
                "--subscription",
                subscription_id,
                "--json",
            ],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=120,
            check=False,
        )
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return MigrationPreview(
            ok=False,
            subscription_id=subscription_id,
            current_plan=current_plan,
            target_plan=target_plan,
            error="simulator timed out",
        )

    if proc.returncode != 0:
        return MigrationPreview(
            ok=False,
            subscription_id=subscription_id,
            current_plan=current_plan,
            target_plan=target_plan,
            error=proc.stderr.strip()[-500:],
        )

    try:
        preview = json.loads(proc.stdout)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return MigrationPreview(
            ok=False,
            subscription_id=subscription_id,
            current_plan=current_plan,
            target_plan=target_plan,
            error="simulator returned invalid JSON",
        )

    return MigrationPreview(
        ok=True,
        subscription_id=subscription_id,
        current_plan=current_plan,
        target_plan=target_plan,
        preview=preview,
    )
